source: User firsthand extended live-game recheck,25 October 2026
report: i've been using cloak of shadows a lot now and tested it thoroughly, and i must have been mistaken: while i have blind on a mob, and that mob is still alive, i cannot recast the skill. if the mob dies, i can, or when the effect ends.

confirmed: A living monster still blinded by this caster prevents recasting the skill.
The lock ends when the affected monsters die or the effect ends.
The earlier apparent unrestricted/fresh-group recasts were a mistaken observation caused by quickly killing the test monsters.
supersedes: Earlier fresh-group bypass and self-defense restart claims as evidence for recasting while living targets remain cloaked.

Empty-area casts, non-blind defense-only targets, curse replacement, cross-caster/rank arbitration and current AI/darkness/remhit edges remain unconfirmed.
nativeAdapter: Recast admission checks this caster's active Cloak curses on all living targets, without range restriction.
